name: baton
description: baton v7: a prime orchestrator that never reads, with a run memory and a project memory instead of a growing context

rotateAtPercent.title: Rotate at percent
rotateAtPercent.description: During an active run, compact the prime and wake it from memory once its context reaches this percent of the window

wakeBudgetLines.title: Wake budget (lines)
wakeBudgetLines.description: The most blocks memory_wake prints: recent notes verbatim, older ones collapsed into summaries

memoryDir.title: Project memory directory
memoryDir.description: Where the project memory (spanning runs) lives, relative to the session's project root

approvals.title: Ask before irreversible commands
approvals.description: During a run, git push, gh pr create/merge/close, publishing, reset --hard and rm -r from any agent wait for your approval (claude -p refuses them). BATON_APPROVALS=0 turns both gates off.

phaseGate.title: Check each finished phase
phaseGate.description: When a sub-orchestrator reports DONE, the prime's next dispatch waits until you approve the phase or send it back with a reason (interactive sessions only)
